description.value: The Vernon Public Art Gallery is the oldest and largest public art gallery in the North Okanagan, with over 60 years of community history and approximately 20 rotating exhibitions per year featuring emerging, mid-career, and established artists working in painting, sculpture, video, and installation art. Located on the ground level of the Vernon Parkade, VPAG is a recognized hub for cultural tourism in the Okanagan and offers a Gallery Shop and Art Rental Program alongside its exhibition programming. Admission is by donation, making it a low-barrier cultural stop for touring cyclists passing through Vernon.

address.value: 3228-31st Ave, Vernon, British Columbia VIT 2H3, Canada
